`You cannot speed up alcohol metabolism` . Your liver processes alcohol at a set rate—roughly one standard drink per hour (lowering blood alcohol concentration by about 0.015% per hour)—and only time allows your body to clear it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF187-34mKq73MVe74MA0Y5YSRw8tOa49MFTWsItRhI9zosw5QtUbhOi7qc-8pLfkZtK1G2qx2M3m17r9ODIY-P-RVnufufmZGabxFcpDxBTFMaVyDZLSOLSTaYmjNLZ7nOCHwPhteUWbRdP5jmsx73cOBKg1XzueiA3xkcEfhrlpYK9CnvT7TW1zu6dd7_v-xU0R2CrXNou8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF152cIYKyyWL3h3fA9tc4abnKS9aL8rrCq6HVS98qU_F8DQLgqB9DXqZh3iE_9xtEuYMkhFfirrtxj1Y8K6lqML3MYPenc1bnz9k5WxECxPwq6w1E4IsZGCR5aqRrLP-EB9vC0UBY-zDHKHLgThLk4XAivVv3QsMrtSx40RwTuknFz1hflPAB2qg27GCZ5DsIBgg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF18wcR2TxBHv5Og607_hRZjhk7BPoUkgVcVGhiLi54nftXfcsHCSXoog810DYwqKN9L4F9dyYSQFc-Uj8aAjU270IwwE7Xn7cjI0-2ra6BioHnFPwDJPKdLOuTFQCyNNmnEuj7uPgDeXnqNxoDfCTzEqxmyKaPm5obrhYjeIHp9PgqQvZFA9Cj0mVTSU8HPGT)

### Common Myths That Don't Work

- **Coffee or energy drinks:** They may make you feel more awake, but they do not lower your blood alcohol concentration or speed up clearance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF152cIYKyyWL3h3fA9tc4abnKS9aL8rrCq6HVS98qU_F8DQLgqB9DXqZh3iE_9xtEuYMkhFfirrtxj1Y8K6lqML3MYPenc1bnz9k5WxECxPwq6w1E4IsZGCR5aqRrLP-EB9vC0UBY-zDHKHLgThLk4XAivVv3QsMrtSx40RwTuknFz1hflPAB2qg27GCZ5DsIBgg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17jl50fX5QF8OdGHPkeSkpagS9aojuEsjKMTULIGiE8bE09wvghuMs3zJIb2gn0kUle72tSr8HPKK1h05ITEOTGtSlgmeqtf_Jmd0E1Ui-KtxMzS00bkUOW_fAF2OPpBSuCXus2HGvsCDqHxBO_5JiE_WBMttu2Qw--9gfGpdH6P5yo)
- **Cold showers or exercise:** Neither pulls alcohol out of your bloodstream faster, and exercising while intoxicated can increase injury or strain on your body.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF19wBm0hJfxDMoCiwM_hhxNTTG2lK3xa_bj3o_K0QwJGmnubNUgVLP9AGdXsjko1QFoDop4uEtF3pGfUbZtBo-uUlbMn5gepYAZ0PIwCkNzt8VRihTG-hcSOpDmFqs-Q9KE6ak1cMfu4DzwduiRl3zP8rj2micC9g87yLeHlMstCRid7o)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF152cIYKyyWL3h3fA9tc4abnKS9aL8rrCq6HVS98qU_F8DQLgqB9DXqZh3iE_9xtEuYMkhFfirrtxj1Y8K6lqML3MYPenc1bnz9k5WxECxPwq6w1E4IsZGCR5aqRrLP-EB9vC0UBY-zDHKHLgThLk4XAivVv3QsMrtSx40RwTuknFz1hflPAB2qg27GCZ5DsIBgg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF18wcR2TxBHv5Og607_hRZjhk7BPoUkgVcVGhiLi54nftXfcsHCSXoog810DYwqKN9L4F9dyYSQFc-Uj8aAjU270IwwE7Xn7cjI0-2ra6BioHnFPwDJPKdLOuTFQCyNNmnEuj7uPgDeXnqNxoDfCTzEqxmyKaPm5obrhYjeIHp9PgqQvZFA9Cj0mVTSU8HPGT)
- **Drinking lots of water:** Hydration helps prevent dehydration and supports comfort, but it does not accelerate liver metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17jl50fX5QF8OdGHPkeSkpagS9aojuEsjKMTULIGiE8bE09wvghuMs3zJIb2gn0kUle72tSr8HPKK1h05ITEOTGtSlgmeqtf_Jmd0E1Ui-KtxMzS00bkUOW_fAF2OPpBSuCXus2HGvsCDqHxBO_5JiE_WBMttu2Qw--9gfGpdH6P5yo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1xweCEXJ6QyVAJTDmU60DJmu2go8m4Deayrk3CBduB47xPTWPGRWqr7qQ6vsv9yg5opmshEq_8WXq-wNGpMqH-KyEFhFEIfrf7pN_9pe4wK1HIn_FA1YKX8KytI7xwj9tB_Q7Y6eEs-xS_f3GZA9S4MRPiGJJfUbmc3ennq5M6FcoKlX7Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF18wcR2TxBHv5Og607_hRZjhk7BPoUkgVcVGhiLi54nftXfcsHCSXoog810DYwqKN9L4F9dyYSQFc-Uj8aAjU270IwwE7Xn7cjI0-2ra6BioHnFPwDJPKdLOuTFQCyNNmnEuj7uPgDeXnqNxoDfCTzEqxmyKaPm5obrhYjeIHp9PgqQvZFA9Cj0mVTSU8HPGT)
- **Commercial "detox" products:** Supplements and detox drinks cannot force your liver to process alcohol faster.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1xweCEXJ6QyVAJTDmU60DJmu2go8m4Deayrk3CBduB47xPTWPGRWqr7qQ6vsv9yg5opmshEq_8WXq-wNGpMqH-KyEFhFEIfrf7pN_9pe4wK1HIn_FA1YKX8KytI7xwj9tB_Q7Y6eEs-xS_f3GZA9S4MRPiGJJfUbmc3ennq5M6FcoKlX7Q)

### What Actually Helps

- **Give your body time:** Wait until your body has finished processing the alcohol before driving or performing tasks requiring coordination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF187-34mKq73MVe74MA0Y5YSRw8tOa49MFTWsItRhI9zosw5QtUbhOi7qc-8pLfkZtK1G2qx2M3m17r9ODIY-P-RVnufufmZGabxFcpDxBTFMaVyDZLSOLSTaYmjNLZ7nOCHwPhteUWbRdP5jmsx73cOBKg1XzueiA3xkcEfhrlpYK9CnvT7TW1zu6dd7_v-xU0R2CrXNou8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF18wcR2TxBHv5Og607_hRZjhk7BPoUkgVcVGhiLi54nftXfcsHCSXoog810DYwqKN9L4F9dyYSQFc-Uj8aAjU270IwwE7Xn7cjI0-2ra6BioHnFPwDJPKdLOuTFQCyNNmnEuj7uPgDeXnqNxoDfCTzEqxmyKaPm5obrhYjeIHp9PgqQvZFA9Cj0mVTSU8HPGT)
- **Eat before or while drinking:** Food slows stomach emptying and alcohol absorption, helping prevent a rapid spike in blood alcohol levels.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17jl50fX5QF8OdGHPkeSkpagS9aojuEsjKMTULIGiE8bE09wvghuMs3zJIb2gn0kUle72tSr8HPKK1h05ITEOTGtSlgmeqtf_Jmd0E1Ui-KtxMzS00bkUOW_fAF2OPpBSuCXus2HGvsCDqHxBO_5JiE_WBMttu2Qw--9gfGpdH6P5yo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1xby1vKJFTmuA14UEKbLoigzWAIY9eP9FuehZuTyqxsozxlfc0NZKoK5BMj6Pud2n-MumvEBtakvCec1qOcRn0NLzFnQvIjtCD86vC2W6pk6cOxhTW2RT2sA7gFUQjcDAh1IFUyLuZIh-NQjca1xK46Z6NjnjeRa96ogKH0sbGQR73DCr2Ycec9vNE1EjImIjhY)
- **Pace your drinks:** Spacing out drinks gives your liver time to keep up rather than becoming overwhelmed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF152cIYKyyWL3h3fA9tc4abnKS9aL8rrCq6HVS98qU_F8DQLgqB9DXqZh3iE_9xtEuYMkhFfirrtxj1Y8K6lqML3MYPenc1bnz9k5WxECxPwq6w1E4IsZGCR5aqRrLP-EB9vC0UBY-zDHKHLgThLk4XAivVv3QsMrtSx40RwTuknFz1hflPAB2qg27GCZ5DsIBgg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17jl50fX5QF8OdGHPkeSkpagS9aojuEsjKMTULIGiE8bE09wvghuMs3zJIb2gn0kUle72tSr8HPKK1h05ITEOTGtSlgmeqtf_Jmd0E1Ui-KtxMzS00bkUOW_fAF2OPpBSuCXus2HGvsCDqHxBO_5JiE_WBMttu2Qw--9gfGpdH6P5yo)
- **Watch for medication interactions:** Certain drugs and liver conditions can slow alcohol processing or cause harmful liver stress.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXJo2FKtDaiUpq-aepkOvP_bS7OUAExR-YC5-gSNQ9eaTx_gSJm45Fzhji6ZAdr87VOf-B9dnVwz9kSTrbkbuyuWTm6GhETgElkQqw5I6TWMrL74tR8bKi7NdPpM-KyLdnLgE3KSiRAVbmjwYJHzwQ3A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF187-34mKq73MVe74MA0Y5YSRw8tOa49MFTWsItRhI9zosw5QtUbhOi7qc-8pLfkZtK1G2qx2M3m17r9ODIY-P-RVnufufmZGabxFcpDxBTFMaVyDZLSOLSTaYmjNLZ7nOCHwPhteUWbRdP5jmsx73cOBKg1XzueiA3xkcEfhrlpYK9CnvT7TW1zu6dd7_v-xU0R2CrXNou8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF152cIYKyyWL3h3fA9tc4abnKS9aL8rrCq6HVS98qU_F8DQLgqB9DXqZh3iE_9xtEuYMkhFfirrtxj1Y8K6lqML3MYPenc1bnz9k5WxECxPwq6w1E4IsZGCR5aqRrLP-EB9vC0UBY-zDHKHLgThLk4XAivVv3QsMrtSx40RwTuknFz1hflPAB2qg27GCZ5DsIBgg)

- **Pace your drinks:** Spacing out drinks gives your liver time to keep up rather than becoming overwhelmed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF152cIYKyyWL3h3fA9tc4abnKS9aL8rrCq6HVS98qU_F8DQLgqB9DXqZh3iE_9xtEuYMkhFfirrtxj1Y8K6lqML3MYPenc1bnz9k5WxECxPwq6w1E4IsZGCR5aqRrLP-EB9vC0UBY-zDHKHLgThLk4XAivVv3QsMrtSx40RwTuknFz1hflPAB2qg27GCZ5DsIBgg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17jl50fX5QF8OdGHPkeSkpagS9aojuEsjKMTULIGiE8bE09wvghuMs3zJIb2gn0kUle72tSr8HPKK1h05ITEOTGtSlgmeqtf_Jmd0E1Ui-KtxMzS00bkUOW_fAF2OPpBSuCXus2HGvsCDqHxBO_5JiE_WBMttu2Qw--9gfGpdH6P5yo)
- **Watch for medication interactions:** Certain drugs and liver conditions can slow alcohol processing or cause harmful liver stress.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXJo2FKtDaiUpq-aepkOvP_bS7OUAExR-YC5-gSNQ9eaTx_gSJm45Fzhji6ZAdr87VOf-B9dnVwz9kSTrbkbuyuWTm6GhETgElkQqw5I6TWMrL74tR8bKi7NdPpM-KyLdnLgE3KSiRAVbmjwYJHzwQ3A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF187-34mKq73MVe74MA0Y5YSRw8tOa49MFTWsItRhI9zosw5QtUbhOi7qc-8pLfkZtK1G2qx2M3m17r9ODIY-P-RVnufufmZGabxFcpDxBTFMaVyDZLSOLSTaYmjNLZ7nOCHwPhteUWbRdP5jmsx73cOBKg1XzueiA3xkcEfhrlpYK9CnvT7TW1zu6dd7_v-xU0R2CrXNou8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF152cIYKyyWL3h3fA9tc4abnKS9aL8rrCq6HVS98qU_F8DQLgqB9DXqZh3iE_9xtEuYMkhFfirrtxj1Y8K6lqML3MYPenc1bnz9k5WxECxPwq6w1E4IsZGCR5aqRrLP-EB9vC0UBY-zDHKHLgThLk4XAivVv3QsMrtSx40RwTuknFz1hflPAB2qg27GCZ5DsIBgg)
